components.note: 阝 (city) — on the right side 阝 is the "city / place" element, as in 都 capital, 那 that, 邮 mail; 邪 itself is a loose-sounding, mostly abstract character (evil).
走 (walk, run) — marks movement on foot, as in 起 rise, 越 cross, 超 surpass; 赶 is chasing or hurrying to catch up.
干 (gān) — gives the sound — 赶 is gǎn, same syllable with a different tone; 秆 gǎn and 肝 gān share it.
風 (traditional wind) — 风 is the simplified form of 風, which had 凡 (fán) as a loose sound hint around 虫; the simplified shape is just a reduced form.
木 (wood, tree) — wood radical — 格 first meant a wooden frame or lattice, hence "pattern, standard"; compare 树 tree, 板 board.
各 (gè) — same syllable, different tone — 格 is gé; 各 also sounds out 阁 gé and 胳 gē.
辶 (movement, road) — the "walk/road" radical appears in characters of going and moving — 过, 进, 送, 逃; here it shows running after something.
纟 (silk, thread) — simplified 糸 (silk thread); early paper was made from silk and fibres, so 纸 sits with 红, 线, 给.
氏 (shì) — only a loose sound hint today — 纸 is zhǐ while 氏 is shì.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — bird element as in 难, 谁, 集; in 雇 it is historical, so just treat it as a part.
户 (hù) — sounds out 雇 gù — close (same final, h→g); 户 also sounds out 顾 gù, so 雇 and 顾 sound alike.
页 (head, page) — 页 marks the head or face, as in 题, 顶, 领, 额; 颜 is the face and, by extension, its colour.
彦 (yàn) — same sound, different tone — 颜 is yán; 彦 also sounds out 谚 yàn.
艹 (grass, plants) — plant radical for herbs and greens, as in 花, 草, 菜; 莱 originally named a weed.
来 (lái) — same sound as 莱 — handy since 莱 mostly appears in foreign names like 好莱坞.
土 (earth) — earth radical for ground, banks and structures, as in 地, 城, 块; 坞 is an earthen bank or dock.
乌 (wū) — same sound — 坞 is wū, matching 乌 (crow), and 好莱坞 is Hollywood.
火 (fire) — fire above a person (儿 legs) — a person carrying fire gives light; 光 is bright and shining, as in 阳光, 时光.
儿 (legs, person) — the bottom 儿 is a walking person, seen also in 先, 兄, 元.
亻 (person) — person radical (单人旁) — 价 is about what people pay or the worth of things; also in 你, 他, 住.
介 (jiè) — near-sound hint — 价 is jià; 介 also sounds out 界 jiè and 阶 jiē.
亻 (person) — person radical, used for 仔 as "small creature or child", as in 牛仔 cowboy and 仔细 careful.
子 (zǐ) — same sound — 仔 is zǐ; 子 also means child, so sound and meaning agree.
纟 (silk, thread) — simplified 糸; thread is the classic fine thing, so 细 means thin, slender, then detailed — as in 线 line, 红 red.
工 (work, craft) — craft and skill — clever handiwork; also in 左, 差.
丂 (kǎo) — near sound — 巧 qiǎo; 丂 also sounds out 考 kǎo and 烤 kǎo.
互 (mutual) — the shape looks like two hooks locking into each other — a handy picture for "mutually" in 互相.
厂 (shelter) — 厂 here is a simple shed or building; 厕 is the small room set apart for the toilet, as in 厕所.
则 (zé) — same final — 厕 is cè; 则 also sounds out 侧 cè and 测 cè, so all three share the sound.
辛 (bitter, harsh) — 辛 hints at hardship and punishment, as in 辣 spicy, 辩; 辜 is guilt, in 无辜 innocent.
古 (gǔ) — same sound, different tone — 辜 is gū; 古 also sounds out 姑 gū and 估 gū.
彳 (step, walk) — left-step radical, like 行 in 径, 往, 德; 彻 is passing all the way through.
切 (qiē, qiè) — loose hint only — 彻 is chè, and the old form of 彻 was different, so the sound clue today is weak.
禾 (grain) — grain radical — 程 first meant to measure grain, hence standard, then course and journey; also in 种, 秋, 稿.
呈 (chéng) — same sound — 程 is chéng; 呈 also sounds out 逞 chěng.
申 (lightning) — 申 pictured a flash of lightning; the later character 电 grew out of it, and 申 stays as the phonetic in 伸 shēn, 神 shén and 绅 shēn.
民 (people) — one old theory sees an eye pierced by a pointed tool, a mark of those with no rights; the meaning "ordinary people" is what to remember.
忄 (heart) — heart radical for feelings, as in 怕 afraid, 情, 慌; 惧 is the feeling of fear.
具 (jù) — same sound — 具 sounds out 俱 jù and 惧 jù.
弓 (bow) — the vertical stroke 丨 is the string being drawn back on a bow — 引 is to pull, then to attract and to cite.
讠 (speech) — simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话, 读; 讶 is the exclamation of surprise.
牙 (yá) — near sound — 讶 is yà; 牙 also sounds out 芽 yá.
木 (wood) — wood radical — tables are wooden furniture, like 椅 chair, 板 board.
卓 (zhuō) — same sound as 桌 zhuō — a clear sound clue.
比 (bǐ) — near sound — 毕 is bì; 比 also sounds out 毙 bì, so the shared syllable bì is easy to remember.
日 (sun) — sun radical — dark is the lack of daylight; compare 明 bright, 晚 evening.
音 (yīn) — loose sound hint — 暗 is àn; 音 also sounds out 谙 ān.
父 (father) — 父 marks older male relatives, as in 爸 dad; 爷 is grandfather.
耶 (yé) — the old form 爺 had 耶 giving the sound yé — the simplified 爷 keeps just a trace of it.
厂 (shelter) — 厂 stands for a building or shelter, as here — 厨 is the room where food is cooked, in 厨房 kitchen and 厨师 chef.
歹 (death, bad) — 歹 is the "bad or death" radical, in 死, 残; 殊 first meant to cut off, then different, special.
朱 (zhū) — near sound — 殊 is shū; 朱 also sounds out 株 zhū and 珠 zhū.
兵 (soldier) — old forms show two hands (the 八 at the bottom) holding an axe (the top, now written 丘), so weapons in hand means soldier.
尸 (roof, body) — 尸 acts as a roof or shelter here, as in 居 and 层; 屋 is a covered place.
至 (arrive) — 至 is where one arrives, so 屋 is a place you get to and stay — a room or house.
阝 (city) — right-side 阝 is 邑 city — 都 is a capital, as in 首都; compare 那, 邮.
者 (zhě) — loose hint — 都 is dū; 者 also sounds out 赌 dǔ and 堵 dǔ, a dū/dǔ series.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is the money radical — 财, 贵, 买, 费; betting stakes money.
者 (zhě) — near hint — 赌 is dǔ; 者 also sounds out 堵 dǔ and 都 dū.
口 (mouth) — mouth radical for speaking and sounds, as in 吃, 叫, 吗; 唱 is to sing.
昌 (chāng) — same sound, different tone — 唱 is chàng; 昌 also sounds out 倡 chàng.
欠 (yawn, open mouth) — 欠 shows a person with an open mouth, as in 吹 blow, 欢 joyful; 歌 is the mouth opened in song.
哥 (gē) — same sound — 歌 is gē, just like 哥; 哥 means elder brother.
亻 (person) — person radical — 伦 is about human relations and order, 伦理 ethics.
仑 (lún) — same sound — 仑 also sounds out 轮 lún and 论 lùn.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 is a hand holding a stick, in verbs of action, as in 教, 放, 收; 敦 itself mostly appears in 伦敦 London.
享 (xiǎng) — the left part is not a reliable sound clue; 敦 dūn is the clue in 墩 dūn and 蹲 dūn.
戈 (spear) — two hands (廾) holding a spear: guarding against danger — hence warn, abstain, and 戒指 ring, from the old sense of guarding.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is the money/gift radical — congratulating often meant sending a gift; compare 财, 买.
加 (jiā) — 加 means add and was the sound clue; today the sound has drifted (贺 is hè).
木 (wood, tree) — 条 was a long slender twig, so branch, strip, and then the measure word for long things; 木 as in 树, 板.
千 (thousand) — 千 is a number built on the old form of 人 with an extra stroke; its sound is also in 迁 qiān.
萬 (traditional ten thousand) — 万 is the simplified form of 萬, which pictured a scorpion borrowed for the number 10,000; 万 also sounds out 迈 mài.
告 (gào) — loose hint — 靠 is kào; 告 also sounds out 造 zào and 酷 kù.
非 (not) — two wings pointing away from each other, so back to back; as a memory aid, 靠 is leaning your back on something.
见 (see) — 见 as in 现, 观, 觉; 规 first meant a compass, the drawing tool that sets the standard — hence rules, as in 规矩 compass and square.
夫 (fū) — loose sound hint — 规 is guī.
巾 (cloth) — 巾 for cloth and wearables, as in 布, 帐, 带; 帽 is a cloth head covering.
冒 (mào) — same sound — 帽 is mào, matching 冒.
十 (ten, many) — traditional 協 pairs 十 with three 力 (strength) side by side: many forces joined in effort, so cooperation.
